entities.summary: The Jameh Mosque of Lar is a Friday mosque, located in the old city of Lar, also known as Shahr-e Qadim, in Larestan County, in the south of the province of Fars, Iran. The mosque was built in 1317 CE, during the Ilkhanid and Safavid eras. The mosque is situated in the Ardfurushan neighborhood, on northern Modarres Street, old city of Lar.
